body.name: published \(p=2\) sharp score and endpoint identity
body.construction: Watson et al. (2024, Corollary 2.1 and Appendix A.7) establish, for the scalar \(L_2\) leakage model with \(p=2\), the sharp identity \(\Theta_I(P)=\{\theta\in K:q_P(\theta)\leq0\}\). If \(\delta(P)<0\), this set is empty. If \(\delta(P)\geq0\), the raw analytic endpoints are defined and the identity becomes \(\Theta_I(P)=K\cap[\theta_-(P),\theta_+(P)]\). This identity is a published input, not a contribution of the project.
